web.title: Cash App Business Fees
web.description:
# Cash App Business Fees
Cash App Business pricing was created with small business owners in mind. Cash App Business accounts are free to create and require no additional hardware to process business payments.

Cash App will automatically deduct a processing fee on each payment you receive to your Cash App Business account. These fees are used to help transfer your customer’s money from their bank or credit card to your account and include:

- A 2.6% + $0.15 processing fee on each payment you receive from your customer’s Cash App account to your Cash App Business account
- A 3% processing fee for each payment accepted via Tap to Pay

When you receive a payment from a customer on your Cash App Business account, the amount you receive in your balance will already have these fees deducted. You can view the processing fees associated with a transaction in your Activity tab:

1. Open the **Activity** tab in the bottom-right corner of your Cash App home screen
2. Scroll through your payment history
3. Select a payment for specific details, including fees

You can transfer the funds in your balance to a linked card or bank account, which may have fees depending on your [deposit speed](https://cash.app/help/3073-cash-out-speed-options).
